title: Masala Chai
steps: Boil water with ginger, cardamom, and cloves
Add tea leaves, milk, and sugar
Simmer for 5 minutes and strain before serving

title: Pakoras (Fritters)
steps: Mix gram flour with spices and water to make batter
Dip sliced vegetables in batter
Deep fry until golden and crispy

title: Pav Bhaji
steps: Boil and mash vegetables
Cook with butter, onions, tomatoes, and pav bhaji masala
Serve hot with toasted pav buns

title: Samosa
steps: Prepare dough with flour and oil
Make filling with boiled potatoes, peas, and spices
Fill, fold into triangles, and deep fry until golden

title: Jalebi
steps: Make fermented batter with flour and yogurt
Pipe into hot oil in spiral shapes
Fry until crisp and dip in sugar syrup

title: Medu Vada
steps: Soak urad dal and grind into thick batter
Add spices and shape into rings
Deep fry until golden brown and serve with chutney and sambar

title: Aloo Paratha
steps: Make dough with wheat flour
Prepare potato filling with spices
Roll dough, stuff with filling, cook on tawa with ghee or butter

title: Pohe
steps: Wash poha and keep aside
Fry mustard seeds, curry leaves, onions, and peanuts
Add turmeric, poha, salt, and lemon juice, mix well and serve

title: Bread Sandwich
steps: Butter bread slices
Spread chutney and layer with vegetables
Cover with another slice and cut into halves

title: Chole Bhature
steps: Cook chickpeas with onion, tomato, and spices to make chole
Prepare dough with flour and yogurt, roll into bhature, deep fry and serve
